sam_sales: Claire at HarborMall asked for a tight POC: websocket streaming + function calls that emit strict JSON per tenant. Need pricing for a 90-day trial (~5M tokens/day), SAML, and KMS plan. Also a one-page infra runbook. Any quick blockers?
claire_cust: yes please include ephemeral token rotation example and how failures are surfaced.
neha_se: Plan: hosted demo for kickoff; Dedicated if they need SLA or tenant isolation. Checklist: SAML metadata from their IdP, KMS intent (BYOK vs managed), JSON schemas for functions, p95 latency target, and expected burst profile.
neha_se: SDK example (py) we'll hand off for streaming + function loop:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
with cli.stream(model="redwood-chat-1") as s:
    s.send({"input":"Get returns for tenant=12","functions":[{"name":"get_returns","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"tenant_id":{"type":"integer"}}}}]})
    for ev in s.recv():
        if ev.type=="function_call":
            resp = get_returns(ev.args)
            s.send({"function_response": resp})
        elif ev.type=="chunk":
            print(ev.text, end='')
```
frank_prod: Security quick answers: TLS1.3, AES-256 at rest, option for customer KMS in Private deployments, audit logs available. I'll attach the SOC2 summary.
kyle_infra: Handshake/runbook: request ephemeral token from auth bridge (TTL=1h), connect via websocket, rotate every 45 minutes by reconnecting. Avoid swapping tokens mid-stream. Provide sample curl/wscat snippets.
claire_cust: good. when can we demo?
sam_sales: Propose Mon 9am PT. We'll include infra and security.
neha_se: Action items: I'll post the SDK sample + a tiny schema test harness by EOD; Kyle will publish the runbook; Frank attach security artifacts; Sales to collect SAML metadata and set calendar.
